```{r}
# Load necessary packages ----

library(tidyr)
library(IncidencePrevalence)

library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

library(forcats)

```

```{r}
# DARWIN style for visOmopResults plots and tables.
style <- NULL
tableType <- "flextable"
plotType  <- "ggplot"
setGlobalPlotOptions(style = style, type = plotType) 
setGlobalTableOptions(style = style, type = tableType)
source(here("functions.R"))
# Load the data
data <- read_csv()
```

Table 1. Number of individuals with polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS) during the study period, by study objective and data source 
```{r}
data$incidence_attrition |>
  filterSettings(denominator_age_group == "10 to 150") |>
  filterGroup(outcome_cohort_name == "pmos") |>
  filter(variable_name == "number_subjects") |>
  filter(strata_level %in% c("Apply washout - anyone with outcome prior to start excluded")) |>
  tidy() |>
  select("cdm_name", "reason", "variable_name", "estimate_value" = "count") |>
  mutate("reason" = "Total number of eligible population",
         "Study objective" = "-", 
         "additional_requirement" = "-",
         "estimate_type" = "integer",
         "estimate_name" = "count") |>
  rbind(
    data$summarise_cohort_attrition |>
      filter(variable_name == "number_subjects") |>
      arrange(as.numeric(additional_level), cdm_name) |>
      tidy() |>
      mutate("estimate_value" = as.numeric(count)) |>
      select(-c("count", "age_range", "cdm_version", "cohort_definition_id",
                "min_prior_observation", "sex", "cohort_name")) |>
      filter(table_name == "pmos_1", reason_id == max(as.numeric(reason_id))) |>
      select("cdm_name", "reason", "variable_name", "estimate_value") |>
      mutate("reason" = "Total number of individuals with PMOS",
             "Study objective" = "Comorbidities Characterisation and Incidence", 
             "additional_requirement" = "Restrict to first PMOS diagnosis",
             "estimate_type" = "integer",
             "estimate_name" = "count") 
  ) |>
  rbind(
    data$summarise_cohort_attrition |>
      filter(variable_name == "number_subjects") |>
      arrange(as.numeric(additional_level), cdm_name) |>
      tidy() |>
      mutate("estimate_value" = as.numeric(count)) |>
      select(-c("count", "age_range", "cdm_version", "cohort_definition_id",
                "min_prior_observation", "sex", "cohort_name")) |>
      filter(table_name == "pmos_2", reason_id == max(as.numeric(reason_id))) |>
      select("cdm_name", "reason", "variable_name", "estimate_value") |>
      mutate("reason" = "Total number of individuals with PMOS",
             "Study objective" = "Drug Characterisation", 
             "additional_requirement" = "Full year of future contribution of individual",
             "estimate_type" = "integer",
             "estimate_name" = "count") 
  ) |>
  mutate("cdm_name" = factor(cdm_name, levels = c("DK-DHR", "FinOMOP-THL", "SIDIAP", "IPCI", "CPRD GOLD"))) |>
  arrange(cdm_name) |>
  visTable(header = "cdm_name",
           hide = c("cohort_name", "variable_name", "variable_level",
                    "reason_id", "table_name", "estimate_name", 
                    "vocabulary_version", "estimate_type"))
```
\newpage

Table 2. Characterisation of polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS) individuals on 
comorbidities
```{r}
t <- data$summarise_characteristics |>
  filterSettings(table_name == "pmos_1",
                 strata == "age_group") |> 
  filterStrata(age_group == "overall") |>
  filter(! c(estimate_name %in% c("min", "q25", "median", "q75", "max", "mean", "sd") &
               !variable_name %in% c("Age"))) |>
  splitAdditional() |>
  mutate("table_type" = if_else(
    !variable_name %in% c("Cardiometabolic/vascular comorbidities",
                          "Hyperandrogenic/reproductive comorbidities",
                          "Mental health"),
    "Demographic characteristics",
    variable_name)) |>
  mutate("variable_name" = if_else(
    variable_name %in% c("Cardiometabolic/vascular comorbidities",
                         "Hyperandrogenic/reproductive comorbidities",
                         "Mental health"),
    variable_level,
    variable_name
  )) |>
  mutate("variable_level" = if_else(
    variable_level %in% c("-", c("10-17", "18-29", "30-39", "40-49", "≥50")),
    variable_level,
    "_"
  )) |>
  uniteAdditional("table_type") |>
  filter(!variable_name %in% c("Number records", "Cohort start date",
                               "Cohort end date",
                               "Sex", "Prior observation", "Future observation",
                               "Days in cohort", "Days to next record")) |>
  filter(!(variable_name %in% "Age" & estimate_name %in% c("mean", "sd"))) |>
  mutate(variable_name = case_when(
    variable_name == "T2d" ~ "Type 2 diabetes",
    variable_name == "Vte" ~ "VTE",
    variable_name == "Mdsld" ~ "Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease",
    .default = variable_name
  )) 


t |>
  mutate("additional_level" = factor(additional_level, levels = c("Demographic characteristics",
                                                                  "Cardiometabolic/vascular comorbidities",
                                                                  "Hyperandrogenic/reproductive comorbidities",
                                                                  "Mental health"))) |>
  mutate("variable_name" = factor(variable_name, levels = c("Number subjects", "Age", "Age group", 
                                                            sort(unique(t$variable_name[!t$additional_level %in% "Demographic characteristics"]))))) |>
  mutate("cdm_name" = factor(cdm_name, levels = c("DK-DHR", "FinOMOP-THL", "SIDIAP", "IPCI", "CPRD GOLD"))) |>
  arrange(cdm_name, additional_level, variable_name) |>
  visOmopTable(
    estimateName = c(
      "N (%)" = "<count> (<percentage>)",
      "N" = "<count>",
      "Median [Q25 - Q75]" = "<median> [<q25> - <q75>]",
      "Range" = "<min>, <max>"
    ),
    .options = list("decimals" = c("numeric" = 0, "integer" = 0, "percentage" = 2)), 
    hide = c("age_group", "table_name", "cohort_name"), 
    groupColumn = "table_type",
    header = "cdm_name"
  )
```

Figure 1. Annual incidence of recorded polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS) diagnosis, overall and stratified by age group
```{r}
j <- 1
p <- getIncidencePlot(data$incidence, outcome = "pmos")
print(p)
j <- j + 1
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
# Annual incidence of health outcomes in polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS) individuals, overall and stratified by age group.
i_names <- data$incidence |> 
  splitGroup() |> 
  distinct(outcome_cohort_name) |> 
  filter(outcome_cohort_name != "pmos") |> 
  pull("outcome_cohort_name")

for(i in i_names) {
  cat(glue("\n\n\\newpage\n\nFigure {j}. Annual incidence of {gsub('_outcome', '', i)} in polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS) individuals, overall and stratified by age group. \n\n"))
  p <- getIncidencePlot(data$incidence, outcome = i)
  print(p)
  j <- j + 1
}

```

```{r}
#| output: asis
# Figure 10–17. 5-year cumulative incidence of health outcomes in polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS) individuals, overall and stratified by age.
for(i in unique(data$survival$variable_level)) {
  
  cat(glue("\n\n\\newpage\n\nFigure {j}. 5-year cumulative incidence of {gsub('_outcome', '', i)} in polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS) individuals, overall and stratified by age. \n\n"))
  p <- getSurvivalPlot(data$survival, outcome = i, years = 5)
  print(p)
  j <- j + 1
}
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
# Figure 10–17. 5-year cumulative incidence of health outcomes in polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS) individuals, overall and stratified by age.
for(i in unique(data$survival$variable_level)) {

  print(p)
  j <- j + 1
```

Figure S1. Median age at index date by calendar year.
```{r}
data[["summarise_characteristics"]] |>
  dplyr::filter(variable_name == "Age",
                strata_name == "calendar_year",
                strata_level != "overall")  |>
  mutate("cdm_name" = factor(cdm_name, levels = c("DK-DHR", "FinOMOP-THL", "SIDIAP", "IPCI", "CPRD GOLD"))) |>
  arrange(cdm_name) |>
  CohortCharacteristics::plotCharacteristics(
    plotType = "boxplot",
    facet = "cdm_name"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))  

```

\newpage
Figure S2. Median time from the first recorded occurrence of each pre-defined comorbidity of interest to the first recorded PMOS diagnosis.
```{r}
data[["summarise_characteristics"]] |>
  omopgenerics::filterSettings(strata == "age_group") |>
  filterStrata(age_group == "overall") |>
  filterSettings(table_name == "pmos_1") |>
  filter(variable_name %in% c("Cardiometabolic/vascular comorbidities",
                              "Hyperandrogenic/reproductive comorbidities",
                              "Mental health")) |>
  mutate("cdm_name" = factor(cdm_name, levels = c("DK-DHR", "FinOMOP-THL", "SIDIAP", "IPCI", "CPRD GOLD"))) |>
  arrange(cdm_name, variable_name, variable_level) |>
  mutate(
    variable_level = factor(
      variable_level,
      levels = rev(unique(variable_level))
    )
  ) |>
  visOmopResults::boxPlot(
    x = "variable_level",
    colour = "variable_name",
    facet = "cdm_name"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = seq(-30,0, by = 5) * 365.25,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-30,0, by = 5) * 365.25,
    labels = \(x) round(x / 365.25),
    name = "Years"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Cardiometabolic/vascular comorbidities" = "#FFAD0AFF",
      "Hyperandrogenic/reproductive comorbidities" = "#859B6CFF",
      "Mental health" = "#1F83B4FF")
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  labs(colour = "", x = "")
```
